foyer.name: The Foyer
foyer.description: Grand but decaying entryway. Cobwebs drape the chandelier, and cold drafts whisper across the marble floor.

library.name: The Library
library.description: Floor-to-ceiling mahogany shelves lined with rotting leather tomes. The air smells of old paper and rain.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: A tall carved bookcase. One section appears to swing outward.

kitchen.name: The Kitchen
kitchen.description: A cavernous scullery with cold iron stoves and rusted butcher hooks. A flight of stone steps leads downward.

down.blockedText: The cellar stairs vanish into a black you cannot walk into.

cellar.name: The Cellar
cellar.description: Damp subterranean vault. Water drips steadily in the darkness. To the north stands a heavy reinforced iron gate.

north.blockedText: The cellar gate answers only to iron.

nursery.name: The Nursery
nursery.description: A frozen nursery with peeling wallpaper showing withered flowers. A tiny rocking horse sits motionless.

attic.name: The Attic
attic.description: Beneath steeply pitched rafters, thick layers of dust blanket forgotten trunks and broken furniture.

trunk.name: trunk
trunk.description: A heavy iron-banded trunk covered in dust.

conservatory.name: The Conservatory
conservatory.description: Shattered glass panes look out upon moonlit overgrown grounds. Dead vines choke decorative iron tables.

flowerpot.name: flowerpot
flowerpot.description: A cracked ceramic planter filled with dried earth.

crypt.name: The Crypt
crypt.description: Ancient vaulted stone sanctuary. The air is quiet and bitterly cold. A massive stone sarcophagus rests in the center.

coffin.name: stone coffin
coffin.description: A weathered stone coffin where Eleanor's remains lie at rest.

matches.name: matches
matches.description: A box of sulfur matches with several strikes remaining.

salt.name: salt
salt.description: A pouch of coarse ritual salt.

journal_page.name: journal page
journal_page.description: A torn page from the master's diary proving Hale's innocence in the tragic events.

iron_key.name: iron key
iron_key.description: A heavy, cold iron key engraved with an hourglass.

music_box.name: music box
music_box.description: An intricately carved wooden music box. It requires a winding key to play.

winding_key.name: winding key
winding_key.description: A small brass key meant for clockwork mechanisms.

silver_locket.name: silver locket
silver_locket.description: A tarnished silver locket containing a tiny portrait of young Eleanor.

eleanor.name: Eleanor
eleanor.personality: A mournful, restless young spirit trapped by sorrow and stolen memories. She shifts between childish grief and spectral wrath.

hints.text: Give it back… give it back…
My locket. My song. My bed of stone.

hale.name: Hale
hale.personality: An austere, bound butler anchored to the house by wrongful accusations. Formal, weary, and guarded until shown truth.

hints.text: The mistress kept her treasures high, where the dust settles.
The cellar gate answers only to iron.
She hums the nursery tune. Play it where she sleeps.

interactions.subject: candle
interactions.successText: You strike a match against the box and touch flame to the wick. The candle flares to life, casting flickering light across the shadows.

interactions.subject: bookshelf
interactions.successText: You pull at the edge of the shelf. With a dry groan, a hidden compartment pops open, revealing a yellowed journal page.

interactions.subject: journal_page
interactions.successText: Hale takes the yellowed page with trembling hands. His hollow eyes widen as he reads. 'Then... I was never blamed. Thank you. Take this key; the crypt below must be consecrated.'

interactions.subject: trunk
interactions.successText: The rusty latch yields with a sharp click. The heavy lid creaks open, revealing a tarnished silver locket nestled within.

interactions.subject: winding_key
interactions.successText: You insert the winding key into the music box and turn it until tight. The clockwork mechanism hums softly with coiled potential.

interactions.subject: iron_key
interactions.successText: The iron key slides into the corroded lock. With a heavy clunk, the crypt gate unlocks.

interactions.subject: music_box
interactions.successText: You open the music box. A delicate, eerie lullaby echoes through the stone arches. A cold mist gathers, and Eleanor's pale figure drifts into the chamber, mesmerized by the melody.

interactions.subject: silver_locket
interactions.successText: You gently rest the silver locket upon the stone lid. Eleanor gazes upon the portrait, tears of silver light falling from her cheeks. A peaceful sigh sweeps through the crypt as her spirit dissolves into warmth. The house is at peace.

interactions.subject: silver_locket
interactions.successText: Eleanor reaches out a translucent hand toward the locket, touching the cool metal with reverence. 'My locket...' she whispers, unable to hold it yet. She smiles faintly.

ending.text: The curse on the manor is broken. Eleanor rests at last in the quiet earth, and the shadows retreat.
